THE COMPONENT REFERENCE SITE IS BUILT BY `pnpm docs:site` AND PUBLISHED BY CI, never by an agent — .github/workflows/docs-site.yml, guarded the way chromatic.yml is. Output is gitignored: a checked-in page is one more generated artifact that can go stale while asserting it is current. The deployed URL lands in the workflow run's summary.

EDITING TARGETS ARE NOW A LOOKUP: `pnpm sync-map` for every component with a gap, `node scripts/check-sync-map.mjs --component Table` for one component's source file, story files, story ids, Figma node and defect count. docs/sync-map.json is the same data for agents.

THE ONLY REMAINING SYNC GAP THAT IS REAL WORK: 41 of 88 library components have no Figma node. Story coverage is 120/120 and variable drift is 2, so Figma components are the last axis out of sync. Follow figma/COMPONENT-DRAWING-RECIPE.md; the 41 are listed by category in `pnpm figma:disposition`.

3 STORY FILES RESOLVE TO NO COMPONENT IN THE MANIFEST, and two of them are a real inconsistency to decide: HistoryCard and NotFoundPattern have source files, have Storybook stories, and are exported from src/index.ts (so `import { HistoryCard } from '@hirobius/design-system'` works) — yet the manifest does not list them, because both are marked @internal + @doc-exempt. Either they belong in the manifest or they should not be in the public barrel; removing an export is breaking, so this is Adrian's call. The third, static-primitives.stories.tsx, imports nothing and is CSS-only — fine as-is.

13 COMPONENTS CARRY RENDERED DEFECTS, now attributable by name rather than by memory: Table (5), Breadcrumb (4), CinematicLink, DateTimeInput, DateInput, Carousel, StackedCardRail, Tokenizer, Disclosure, HdsSlider, SegmentedControl, Sketch, VisuallyHidden. FIX ORDER BY BLAST RADIUS: (1) Table — a primitive every pattern composes, Token column is 240px against 258px of content. (2) DateTimeInput — 2 controls rendering at 0x0, the only unclickable elements in the system. (3) Breadcrumb — 9 link-no-affordance, a WCAG 1.4.1 failure. (4) StackedCardRail — 13 overflow-x, but #133 may delete it, so confirm before spending.

32 small-target FINDINGS ARE ONE SYSTEM-WIDE QUESTION, NOT 32 BUGS: Tokenizer (8), Disclosure (6), HdsSlider (6), DateInput (4). WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8 wants 24px. If the answer is a minimum hit-area on every interactive primitive, that is one token and one shared class.

check-rendered-geometry IS STILL on-demand AND THAT IS HONEST — it needs a built Storybook (~2 min) so it cannot join the pre-commit set. Wiring it to ci-pr is a .github/workflows edit, which IS pushable from a remote session (#267 proved it). Do NOT relabel the channel without wiring it.

ZERO STORIES HAVE play() FUNCTIONS (hds#285 — the prior '56' here counted files matching /play:/, which matched `display:` inside inline styles; the true count is 0 and @storybook/test-runner is NOT installed). Interaction testing via play() + @storybook/test-runner remains a real, unstarted option — it would share infrastructure with check-rendered-geometry (a built Storybook + Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers) — but it is greenfield work, not wiring something already there.
MERGE ORDER, all three are mine, all green, all independent: #267 (release PAT — merge FIRST, it unblocks every publish), #268 ('use client'), #269 (props exports).
AFTER #267 MERGES: re-run the Release workflow (Actions -> Release -> Run workflow) so PR #266 "Version Packages" is re-authored by RELEASE_PAT and finally gets checks.
A RED CI DOES NOT STOP A PUBLISH. .github/workflows/release.yml has no `needs:`, no `workflow_run` and no `if:` tying it to the CI workflow.
A COMPONENT CAN VANISH FROM THE PUBLISHED BARREL WITH CI GREEN. pretest runs audit-component-integrity with --completeness but never --api. Adding --api to pretest is ~8 lines.

CHROMATIC CANNOT FAIL A PR EVEN ONCE ENABLED: .github/workflows/chromatic.yml:51 sets exitZeroOnChanges: true. As configured it is a report, not a gate — and check-rendered-geometry now covers part of what it was wanted for.
CI HAS NO SECRETS SCAN. gitleaks is referenced in no .github/workflows file and check-secrets is pre-commit only, where it skips silently when the binary is absent.
RECONCILE severity WITH REALITY: several gates say severity warn while exiting 1 in pretest and therefore blocking CI.

TWO GENERATED ARTIFACTS ARE STILL STALE AND NOTHING REGENERATES THEM: docs/security/sbom.json, docs/audits/exceptions-audit.md. docs/audits/TIER_AUDIT.md no longer silently regenerates a fabricated report (hds#264 added a vacuity guard — the walker now refuses to run and exits 1, naming that its Hds*.tsx pattern matches 0 of the 196 kebab-case component files) but the classifier itself still needs the rewrite-or-delete decision hds#264 left open.
#257 — Radio animates backgroundColor/borderColor to var() strings framer-motion cannot interpolate, so the colour transition silently never runs.
THE BIGGEST DESIGNER-FACING WIN, still never run: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN=<token> pnpm figma:links --dev-resources --dry-run, then without --dry-run.

hds#285 SWEEP: the play() line was the only false integer found this session. Cross-checked against live derivation: 139 components / 91 synced / story coverage 120-of-120 / Figma 47-of-88 / 41 missing a Figma node / 13 rendered-defect components (names match exactly) / 3 orphan story files, all via `node scripts/check-sync-map.mjs --json`; storiesSwept 447 and accepted-baseline 57 via docs/guardrails/rendered-geometry-baseline.json. One claim could not be confirmed OR refuted this session for lack of a live browser run: DateTimeInput's '2 controls rendering at 0x0' — the baseline records defect kind + selector, not pixel magnitude, so this is a real gap in what's checkable, not a known-false claim; re-verify with a live check-rendered-geometry run before repeating it. Decision (DoD): derived counts stay in status.json's prose — rewriting it as structured data was out of scope here — but any claim that already has a re-derivable source must be backed by a generated witness a `--check` gate compares against, the same pattern check-sync-map and figma:staging-inventory already use. `pnpm check:status-claims` is the first instance, covering the play() count; docs/guardrails/status-claims.json is the witness. Extending it to the sync-map numbers above is redundant with check-sync-map.mjs itself (already gated pre-commit) and was left alone.

resolvedThisSession: FOUR GUARDRAIL-REGISTRY GATES BUILT OR FIXED IN ONE PUSH (hds#264, #270, #277, #249) — all registered, validate-guardrail-registry + check-validator-wiring green. hds#264: audit-tiers.mjs's walker matched 0 of 196 real component files (kebab-case now, pattern still Hds*.tsx) and kept writing docs/audits/TIER_AUDIT.md anyway, "audit walked 0 source files" sitting there since June as if that were a finding. assertNotVacuous() now exits 1 before any report is built, naming the pattern and what the tree actually holds; canary at fixtures/audit-tiers/empty-components.example.d/. Targeted .gitignore added for the 9 tsconfig.dts.json entry points a stray `tsc` run emits .d.ts next to (src/**/*.d.ts blanket ignore would have caught the 2 legitimate committed ones, so it's per-path). hds#270: check-public-api.mjs's docblock claimed it was 'Added to check:full as api:check and api:update' as if those were its own script names — it's actually invoked as a subprocess of audit-component-integrity.mjs --api, registered under that merged gate id, not its own; docblock corrected. --update-baseline also produced non-Prettier-clean bytes (array-per-line vs. inline short arrays) so every baseline update got silently reformatted by the pre-commit hook; now runs through write-generated.mjs's formatGenerated() like every other generator. Canary: diffSurfaces() proven to report a removed export/module as breaking. hds#277: docs/sync-map.json (2757 lines, '$comment: Do not hand-edit') had no drift gate despite being committed generated output — check-sync-map.mjs --check now recomputes it and diffs byte-for-byte, naming every disagreeing component; wired into pre-commit alongside the plain gate. Canary: hand-editing Button's row makes it exit 1 and name Button. hds#249: nothing enforced the CLAUDE.md rule that status.json gets bumped before a session ends changing project state — this file itself was the proof, caught stale by the new gate. scripts/check-record-freshness.mjs (pre-push, not pre-commit — a push is the state change the fleet dashboard shows) fails when a pushed commit touches src/, scripts/ or docs/adr/ and status.json's updatedAt predates it, and separately when a src/ commit has no pending .changeset/*.md and no skip-changeset marker. 15 tests: in-memory unit tests for the pure diff logic plus a CLI-integration suite against a disposable throwaway git repo (never this session's own tree) proving the real git log/diff-tree wiring.

PR #262 AND #261 ARE MERGED (c1561f5, 22ec2b5). Everything the previous revision of this file marked 'awaiting merge' is now on main: the 150 rewritten .d.ts specifiers and their gate, the registry channel relabel of 24 gates, and the three dead import.meta.env guards.

'use client' SHIPPED PER CHUNK, gated both directions (PR #268, open, green). scripts/lib/rsc-directive.mjs holds the rule so the build plugin and the standing gate cannot drift; check-rsc-directives re-derives it from dist/ rather than trusting the plugin ran. Canary: stripping the directive from dist/scroll.js makes the gate exit 1 naming that file. A spec review called the gate's import regex a confirmed LIVE bug; verified against real dist/ and the claim was wrong — Rollup renders import statements, esbuild only minifies chunk bodies, so imports always arrive spaced (11 scanned, 0 missing, 0 spurious). The fragility was real and was fixed anyway, tests first.

41 PROPS TYPES EXPORTED, gated from pretest (PR #269, open). The rule was written test-first and the tests earned it: the first pass read only an inline `export` modifier and silently missed three forms this codebase leans on — the trailing `export { CardHeader, ... }` in card.tsx, `Object.assign(GridInner, { Item: GridItem })`, and the one class component. Three tests for those went red before the rule grew; two guards (class STATE is not props; an inner component nothing re-exports stays private) went green FIRST, so the fix could not be satisfied by widening the net. Count went 35 -> 41. Canary: dropping `export` from AlertProps makes the gate exit 1 naming alert.tsx:61.

THE RELEASE DEADLOCK DIAGNOSED AND FIXED (PR #267, open, green). THREE DEAD SHIPPED GUARDS, AWAITING MERGE OF PR #261. icon.tsx, deprecation.ts, TenantContext.tsx no longer read import.meta.env. Verified in dist/: zero import.meta.env, zero typeof process, the bare process.env.NODE_ENV member expression present. A first attempt guarded that read with typeof process, which a bundler leaves as a runtime check that a browser bundle always fails, inverting the answer in a production build; measured with esbuild and corrected before merge.

audit-gates-supportjson PROBE COHORT RESTORED, AWAITING MERGE OF PR #262. It selected its cohort with firingChannel !== 'pnpm-meta', so the relabel dropped it from 39 to 15. Now an explicit ID list seeded to match main, failing safe: a gate added tomorrow is included by default.

#236 CLOSED and figma/snapshot.json is on main (PR #258). Proven along the way that no agent can ever take it: the carrier runs fine through use_figma and returns a valid checksum (90bf34df), but use_figma truncates its response at 20 KB while the file is 255 KB — 12.8x — and --ingest checksums the exact bytes. A transport ceiling, not a credential problem. Two earlier failures were misread as transcription error before the runtime was shown to return function source verbatim and all ten functions to transmit byte-perfect; the guard was never at fault. The full DoD, the --json report and where each drift item is tracked are recorded in a closing comment on #236
